svg.text: Global Settings: duration, sampling rate and seed; Load Preset… replaces the whole setup.
Tacho Settings: the speed profile that the order components follow.
One tab per channel: label, unit and its table of components; they add up to the channel signal.
Add Component: appends the type and values chosen in the fields above the table.
Tacho Profile: speed against time (always the clean profile).
Preview of the selected channel only; switch the channel tab to preview another one.
View Settings: X axis, visible time window, View All and View 4 period.
Export Signal: asks for a file name and writes the Siemens Testlab ASC file.
